new_libraries.name: EasyEspAndroid
new_libraries.author: Arul
new_libraries.sentence: A robust library to provision ESP32 to Wi-Fi via an Android app.
new_libraries.paragraph: Pairs seamlessly with the Android EasyEsp KMM library for dual-mode Wi-Fi setup. Features an asynchronous webserver and network scanner.

library.name: ADRF6655
library.author: kinny
library.sentence: Driver for the Analog Devices ADRF6655 broadband up/downconverting mixer with integrated fractional-N PLL and VCO.
library.paragraph: Provides one configuration function per register (R0-R7), a single low-level SPI write primitive, automatic INT/MOD/FRAC calculation from a target LO frequency (exact 64-bit integer math, optional best-fit MOD), and the full deactivate->reconfigure->activate sequence required on every frequency change. Designed for ESP32 control of the ADRF6655 evaluation board over SPI.

library.name: ClearCoreWatchdog
library.author: RobotBuzzard
library.sentence: Hardware watchdog timer for the Teknic ClearCore (Microchip SAME53N19A).
library.paragraph: Direct CMSIS register access to the SAMD51/SAME53 WDT block. Teknic's ClearCore Arduino library does not expose any watchdog API; this fills the gap. Bench-validated on a real ClearCore — deliberate-hang test confirms automatic reset within the configured timeout, bracketed long operations do not trigger spurious resets. Configurable timeouts from 1s to 16s (default 8s), Always-On mode, early-warning callback, reset-cause introspection via RSTC.RCAUSE.

library.name: UNI
library.author: UNI Team <fadeev.iliya.2008@gmail.com>
library.sentence: Educational robotics library for UNI platform with motor control, sensors, and LightRing effects.
library.paragraph: Complete robotics control library featuring dual motor control with encoders, odometry tracking, OLED display, ultrasonic sensors, light ring with 7 built-in effects, traffic light simulation, and button interface. Perfect for educational robotics projects and competitions.
